# CUI

Vendored copy of [CUI](https://github.com/yappologistic/CUI) v1.2.0. Only the
files needed to build the library are kept (`CMakeLists.txt`, `include/`,
`src/`, `third_party/`, licenses).

cuimoji's local changes live directly in the source: faster emoji atlas fills,
Apple Color Emoji tone fallback, the picker keyboard/recent behavior, and the
search ranking hooks. Builds use this tree, not a downloaded copy.
